definitions.explanation: The classification of blood based on the presence of antigens (A, B, AB, O system).

examples.japanese: あなたの{血液型|けつえきがた}は{何|なん}ですか。
{私|わたし}の{血液型|けつえきがた}はA{型|がた}です。
{日本|にほん}では{血液型|けつえきがた}で{性格|せいかく}を{判断|はんだん}する{人|ひと}がいる。
examples.english: In Japan, some people judge personality by blood type.

notes:
{血液型|けつえきがた} combines {血液|けつえき} (blood) + {型|がた} (type).

BLOOD TYPES:
- A{型|がた} (Type A)
- B{型|がた} (Type B)
- O{型|がた} (Type O)
- AB{型|がた} (Type AB)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, blood type is commonly believed to correlate with personality traits, similar to how Western cultures view horoscopes. This belief, while not scientifically supported, is popular in casual conversation, dating, and entertainment.

- A{型|がた}: believed to be organized, cautious
- B{型|がた}: believed to be creative, selfish
- O{型|がた}: believed to be confident, insensitive
- AB{型|がた}: believed to be rational, unpredictable
